changelog:
v5.0 — Catch up on shows you missed, and a new look for movies

• New: Catch Up. Find it on the Home screen. Pick a channel and replay shows that aired over the last 2 days, from the beginning. Works on the channels your provider records (about 235 today, including major US networks, movie channels and sports).

• Movie pages are redesigned to match series. One button plays or resumes, with Start over and Trailer beside it, the cast underneath, and a "More like this" row at the bottom.

• Continue Watching is easier to read. Each card shows the title once, then the episode and how much time is left.

• The Home screen keeps the title and the Play and More Info buttons on screen while a preview plays.

• Live channels recover better. If the picture freezes, the app now restarts the stream instead of switching to a slower decoder, and it no longer shows "format not supported" for channels that normally play fine.

• If your provider's stream server is down, the app now says so, instead of telling you to check your WiFi.

Includes everything from v4.2.18: the new series pages, real episode names, and the improved next-episode card.
